mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which compresses real equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds its 5-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (indicated by industrial production below 100), corporate margins contract and growth expectations decline, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust demand expansion, which boosts economic activity and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises and GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: During a strong labor market recovery (indicated by non-farm payrolls increasing above 100k month-over-month), consumer spending accelerates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by more than 100k month-over-month.
